scope.basis: Compared Astra display fields with the complete source ideas.json, inspected inherited originalAssessment values and the catalog builder, and scanned both sources for ellipses, incomplete endings, and possible first-sentence splitter artifacts. No new scientific caveats or source facts added.

scanSummary.actualCause: The builder appends source assessment.concern verbatim. Thirty-seven concerns are terse fragments without terminal punctuation; A-D09-07 ends with the incomplete shorthand “covered by prior”. These are inherited shorthand, not a fixed-length readiness cut.
scanSummary.intentionalPreviewExplanation: The Fable hook helper deliberately shortens first-sentence previews to 240 characters with a visible ellipsis; complete proposal content remains in experiment/originalAssessment. These were not treated as lost substantive source text.
scanSummary.listExplanation: Short resource lists and complete risk notes without terminal punctuation are intact source entries, not artificial cutoffs. No punctuation-only edits were made to those lists.
scanSummary.postRepair: All 200 readiness reasons end with complete sentences; no non-hook field ends with an artificial ellipsis. Scores, readiness classifications, citations, and factual project scope are unchanged.
